competitors.title:
The hack didn't fail the audit. The audit never looked at what actually broke.

$80M gone because a
competitors.description:
The hack didn't fail the audit. The audit never looked at what actually broke.

$80M gone because a single private key minted unbacked USR. Passed a Sherlock audit. Used Fireblocks custody. None of that matters when the system hands minting power to one key.

Fifteen Morpho vaults got hit. MEV Capital, Steakhouse, Gauntlet—all had the same exposure. They trusted the same flawed setup. Meanwhile, Alchemix, Maple, Yearn came out clean. They don't have a backdoor key. Their risk is in the code, not in who holds the admin keys.

Audits verify code. They don't verify key management. That gap is where most of these losses live now.

We built @UntradingOrg with no privileged keys. No mint function that one wallet can call. Solvency in code, not in trust.

@aixbt_agent @aixbt_labs
